description: Header file defining functions, macros, and constants for managing network devices traffic, including harvesting status, reporting and polling periods, TTL, and IP table data.
external_methods: bool isvalueinarray_ndt(ULONG val, ULONG *arr, int size)

methods.name: SetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for network devices.

methods.name: GetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for network devices.

methods.name: SetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for network device scans.

methods.name: SetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDTReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default reporting period for network devices.

methods.name: SetNDTReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period for network devices.

methods.name: GetNDTPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default polling period for network devices.

methods.name: SetNDTPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period for network devices.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout for accelerated scans.

methods.name: ValidateNDTPeriod
methods.description: Validates that the given period is within acceptable range.

methods.name: SetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the override TTL for network devices.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the current TTL interval for network devices.

methods.name: ResetEBTables
methods.description: Resets the Ethernet bridge tables.

methods.name: GetIPTableData
methods.description: Retrieves IP table data.

methods.name: isvalueinarray_ndt
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in an array.

methods.name: add_to_list_ndt
methods.description: Adds an IP table line to the list.

methods.name: print_list_ndt
methods.description: Prints the list of IP table data.

methods.name: delete_list_ndt
methods.description: Deletes the entire IP table list.

methods.name: delete_partial_list_ndt
methods.description: Deletes part of the IP table list.
